Price slotted rentals by the runs placed on each machine, so seeds sharing a GPU each fund only their share

Needed by manabot MTG-409, a USD10 three-seeds-per-L4 run that admission refuses today (each seed is priced as if it had the machine alone). Spec from that Task's plan:


1. **Fix slotted per-run pricing in Etude, release `etude-sdk==0.4.3`, and bump
   the pin in `manabot`** (`comment:c7a2ed2f-5783-4190-83b1-d043fab8040a`):
   - Work in a clean branch/worktree of `/Users/jack/src/etude` from
     `origin/main` (`v0.4.2`, `2d16a03`; do not disturb existing worktrees
     `/Users/jack/src/etude.fixed-pairs` or `/Users/jack/src/etude.seated`).
   - Revised after testing a nominal per-slot price on Etude v0.4.2. With
     three slots, USD 0.69/hour, zero setup, and each run requesting an hour
     for USD 0.23, the fake provider issued 1,200 seconds for one seed and
     3,600 seconds for three. With four seeds and two machines it issued
     2,400 and 1,200 seconds. The three funded peers can lose their full
     window because `_life` divides all pending dollars equally across
     machines. A configured slot alone cannot fund a run.
   - In Etude, form the actual first-wave placements before checking shares.
     Require enough funds for each new rental's promised window, including
     setup and provider rounding. Quote and launch must use the same funded
     placements. Admit the full three-seed group even with a fourth
     underfunded seed waiting. Cover one, three and four seeds, open
     sessions and queued attempt limits. Keep actual occupancy accounting.
   - Add focused regression tests in `tests/launch/test_slots.py` covering
     `launch`, `quote` and queued `tick` on a multi-slot `OnDemand` where each
     seed funds `1 / slots` of the window (including `setup_seconds`), plus
     rejection when per-run `max_usd` is below that slot share. Run `pytest`,
     `mypy` and `ruff` in Etude, land on `loopflowstudio/etude`, cut and publish
     `v0.4.3` (`lf release-run` / release workflow as in `#129`), and clean up
     any temporary Etude worktree.
   - Bump `etude-sdk` to `0.4.3` across `manabot` (`pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`,
     `scripts/release/validate.py`, `tests/infra/test_release.py`,

The manabot pin bump belongs to MTG-409, not this Task. Releasing v0.4.3 to PyPI is in scope.
